dedupe_keys.name: dataset of dispatch optimization and sizing of molten salt power to heat systems in balancing electricity markets for industrial heat electrification

description: A Czech research team publishes inputs for a molten-salt power-to-heat and thermal-storage dispatch study in the Czech Republic and Germany. Zenodo lists two public CSV files and a text README under CC BY 4.0. The own page describes hourly industrial heat demand, day-ahead and ancillary-market electricity prices and grid emission factors used for sizing and dispatch optimisation. These series can drive process-heat electrification, storage and market-response scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the two-country input package. A limitation is that a study input set may represent selected processes and market years, not the full national industrial heat load. The README contains unfinished placeholder author and licence wording despite the Zenodo CC BY metadata claim, so rights should be checked before downstream reuse. The exact CSV columns, units and period were not verified against file contents. No CSV was downloaded and no dispatch result was reproduced.
